BiblicalUsage: Keluhai, Chelluh, is an Israelite named among those who had taken foreign wives. Ezra 10:35 lists him plainly: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Chelluh's name stands in the list because Ezra's reckoning left no one out, and the people answered it together.
